Remote Project Manager – Kitchen & Bath Remodeling

Kitchen Tune-Up & Bath Tune-Up

Remote Position Supporting North Atlanta, Georgia Projects

Compensation: $12 per hour | Full-Time, 50 Hours per Week

Benefits

Performance-based bonuses
Long-term career advancement opportunities
Remote work
Opportunity to grow with an expanding remodeling company

Create Raving Fans & Make Money!

Kitchen Tune-Up and Bath Tune-Up is seeking an experienced Remote Project Manager
to coordinate residential kitchen and bathroom remodeling projects throughout North Atlanta.

This is a full-time remote position for someone who can successfully coordinate 10-20 active remodeling projects simultaneously
while maintaining exceptional standards for scheduling, client communication, documentation, material ordering, quality control, project cycle times, and budget performance.

Our goal is straightforward: Create Raving Fans & Make Money!

The right candidate has strong experience managing U.S. residential kitchen and bathroom remodeling projects. They are highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, comfortable holding installers and trade partners accountable, and committed to doing things the right way—even when no one is watching.

Compensation

$12 per hour
50 hours per week
Performance-based bonuses tied to measurable results, including:
Client satisfaction and 5-star Google reviews
On-time project completion and cycle times
Budget and gross-margin performance
Accurate and timely material ordering
Project documentation and communication
Minimal delays, rework, callbacks, and warranty issues

Opportunity for increased responsibility and career advancement based on performance

What You’ll Do

You will report to the Operations Manager and remotely coordinate multiple residential remodeling projects from pre-construction preparation through final completion.

Project Management and Scheduling

Coordinate 10-20 active kitchen and bathroom remodeling projects simultaneously
Review project scopes, plans, measurements, selections, specifications, budgets, and schedules before construction begins
Confirm that field measurements and site conditions have been properly documented before materials are ordered
Develop, maintain, and update realistic project schedules
Coordinate installers, trade partners, vendors, deliveries, inspections, and homeowners
Confirm daily installer attendance, progress, and next steps
Identify potential delays, missing materials, or cost overruns early and develop corrective action plans
Keep projects moving efficiently while minimizing downtime between construction phases
Ensure work remains within the approved scope and budget
Track pre-construction walks, start dates, countertop templating, installations, inspections, final walkthroughs, punch lists, completion dates, and outside dates
Protect project gross margin by actively managing labor, materials, change orders, rework, and scheduling

Material Ordering and Production Coordination

Review approved proposals, plans, selections, and measurements before ordering
Prepare and maintain detailed material lists and project-ordering trackers
Coordinate the ordering of cabinetry, cabinet-refacing materials, countertops, tile, plumbing fixtures, hardware, lighting, and related products
Confirm order acknowledgments, lead times, delivery dates, quantities, specifications, and finishes
Track whether materials have been ordered, received, inspected, and assigned to the correct project
Communicate proactively regarding backorders, damaged products, missing materials, and substitutions
Coordinate deliveries with vendors, Field Supervisors, installers, and clients
Help prevent ordering errors, jobsite delays, duplicate purchases, and unnecessary expedited-shipping costs

Quality Control and Documentation

Review daily jobsite photographs, videos, installer reports, and project updates
Confirm that completed work appears consistent with the approved scope, plans, selections, and Kitchen Tune-Up standards
Escalate potential quality concerns to the Field Supervisor or Operations Manager immediately
Maintain accurate project notes, schedules, photographs, documents, and communications in company systems
Track open items, deficiencies, punch-list work, callbacks, and warranty issues through completion
Help reduce rework by identifying inconsistencies, missing information, and potential problems early
Confirm that every project has complete and organized documentation

Client Experience

Provide homeowners with timely and professional project updates
Set clear expectations regarding schedules, upcoming work, required decisions, deliveries, and project milestones
Communicate proactively—especially when challenges, changes, or delays arise
Respond promptly and professionally to client questions and concerns
Coordinate project walkthroughs and ensure punch-list items are documented and resolved
Help create Raving Fans who confidently recommend Kitchen Tune-Up and leave 5-star Google reviews

Installer, Trade Partner, and Team Coordination

Build productive working relationships with installers, trade partners, vendors, and internal team members
Communicate daily with field personnel regarding attendance, progress, materials, quality, and upcoming work
Hold installers and trade partners accountable for schedules, communication, documentation, and commitments
Confirm that installers submit required jobsite photographs, videos, time records, and daily reports
Communicate project risks, delays, client concerns, and resource needs to the Operations Manager
Participate in daily project huddles, production meetings, operations meetings, and client calls
Prepare clear meeting notes, action items, deadlines, and follow-up communications
Follow through until every assigned task and project issue is fully resolved

Budget and Change-Order Management

Monitor project budgets, labor costs, material expenses, and gross-margin performance
Compare proposed work with actual field conditions and client requests
Identify work that falls outside the approved proposal
Prepare change-order information for management review before additional work begins
Track approved change orders and confirm that they are incorporated into schedules and project documentation
Help prevent unauthorized work, unapproved material purchases, and avoidable cost overruns

What Success Looks Like

The Remote Project Manager will be evaluated on their ability to help us Create Raving Fans & Make Money
, including:

Projects completed on schedule
Accurate and continuously updated project schedules
Projects completed within budget and gross-profit targets
Timely and accurate material ordering
Minimal ordering mistakes, delays, rework, callbacks, and warranty claims
Client satisfaction and 5-star Google reviews
Proactive client and team communication
Complete and accurate project documentation
Installer and trade-partner accountability
Fast identification and resolution of project risks
Ability to manage 10-20 active projects without sacrificing quality, client care, or profitability
Consistent ownership, responsiveness, and follow-through

Qualifications

Required

At least 3 years of project-management experience involving U.S. residential construction or remodeling
Direct experience managing kitchen, bathroom, cabinetry, or residential renovation projects
Demonstrated ability to coordinate more than five active projects simultaneously
Strong knowledge of U.S. residential construction methods, terminology, and sequencing
Working knowledge of cabinetry, countertops, tile, plumbing, electrical, flooring, and finish carpentry
Experience reviewing plans, measurements, scopes of work, specifications, and product documentation
Experience coordinating materials, installers, subcontractors, vendors, and project schedules
Strong understanding of quality control, job costing, change orders, and gross-margin management
Excellent written and spoken English
Strong organizational, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills
Ability to communicate professionally with U.S. homeowners, installers, vendors, and team members
Strong computer skills and the ability to learn new software quickly
Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, headset, webcam, and distraction-free home workspace
Ability to remain available and responsive throughout scheduled working hours
Three professional supervisor references

Preferred

Experience with high-end residential remodeling
Experience working remotely for a U.S. construction or remodeling company
Experience with Buildertrend, ServiceMinder, 2020 Design, Microsoft Excel, Google Workspace, Zoom, or comparable systems
Experience ordering cabinetry, refacing materials, countertops, tile, plumbing fixtures, and remodeling products
Experience managing more than 10 active remodeling projects simultaneously
Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills
Relevant construction, design, estimating, or project-management education or certifications

Schedule

Full-time: 50 hours per week
Monday through Saturday
Must be available during the company’s required working hours in the U.S. Eastern Time Zone
Attendance at daily huddles, production meetings, operations meetings, and client calls is required
Occasional evening availability may be required based on client or project needs
This is a remote position, but it requires consistent availability, professional communication, and active engagement throughout the workday

Who Thrives Here

You May Be a Strong Fit If You:

Take complete ownership and follow through
Hold yourself and others accountable at an A-player level
Notice details others miss
Communicate problems early instead of allowing surprises
Respond promptly and understand that radio silence is unacceptable
Respect clients, teammates, installers, trade partners, and their time
Remain calm, resourceful, and solutions-focused under pressure
Can manage multiple priorities without losing track of details
Understand that excellent client service and profitable operations go hand in hand
Always strive to do the right thing

Kitchen Tune-Up provides kitchen remodeling and improvement solutions designed to transform clients’ homes while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

We believe remodeling should improve both the beauty of a home and the lives of the people who live there. We combine thoughtful planning, excellent craftsmanship, proactive communication, and disciplined project management to deliver outstanding results.

Client Experience: Treat every homeowner and home with care, honesty, and respect.
Quality: Deliver craftsmanship we are proud to stand behind.

Communication: Keep clients and teammates informed—no surprises and no radio silence.

Apply Today

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
Silicon Quantum Computing (SQC) is at the forefront of global efforts to build the world’s first commercial-scale quantum computer, while delivering quantum-enhanced AI and simulation products to customers today.

Backed by over 25 years of technological excellence, SQC is a full-stack quantum computing company that leverages its proprietary manufacturing process to engineer atomic qubits in silicon with 0.13 nanometer precision. It is the most precise semiconductor manufacturing in the world, enabling systems with world-leading algorithmic fidelity, and a decisive advantage in the global quantum computing race.

Our products are commercially deployed and generating revenue. Watermelon, our quantum-enhanced AI system, is delivering superior results on real-world problems across energy, telecom and finance. Quantum Twins, our simulation platform, provides unparalleled ability to model quantum systems, accelerating molecule and materials discovery.

This is SQC: building the future of computing while delivering quantum impact today.

About The Role

SQC builds gate-based quantum computers in silicon. Our largest programmes are multi-year commitments to US government sponsors, delivered against fixed benchmarks, milestones and independent evaluation. We are hiring a Technical Project Manager into Projects, the team that plans and delivers those programmes.

You will own the detailed schedule end to end, across hardware tasks, software workstreams and partner deliverables, not just the high-level roadmap. That means holding a critical path that runs through fabrication, measurement, engineering and external subcontractors, and running structured risk assessment as a standing discipline rather than an occasional exercise. Predictability is the core of the job. You will flag early that a milestone is at risk of slipping rather than surfacing it after the fact, and when new information or a blocker lands, you will adjust the plan quickly and make the consequences clear to the people who need to act on them.

You will own the commercial side of the programme too: the budget, tracked against the annual projections we hold with our investors, with variances flagged early and visible to management, alongside funding proposals and the subcontractors delivering into the programme. You will own the government interface, including the independent verification and validation relationship, keeping internal schedules aligned to sponsor milestones and holding the programme accountable to the exit criteria it will be judged against. You will also support our quantum machine learning customer interface, keeping programme schedules and customer commitments aligned, keeping QML customers informed of deliverable timelines and test results as they feed into the programme, and escalating commercial priorities or scope changes rather than absorbing them into the plan.

Based at our Sydney facility, you will work across nearly every team in the business, moving between technical detail with engineers, clear synthesis for management, and concise updates for the executive and the CEO. This is a role for someone with a genuine project management mindset: structured, disciplined about following defined processes rather than improvising case by case, personally committed to milestones, and comfortable challenging engineering estimates, holding teams to their commitments and pushing back when delivery slips.

Role responsibilities

Own the detailed delivery schedule across multiple workstreams, covering hardware tasks alongside software and partner deliverables
Build and maintain a credible critical path, and keep multi-team work moving transparently and to a high technical bar
Run structured risk assessment as a recurring responsibility, identifying dependencies early and maintaining mitigation plans against them
Flag milestone risk before it materialises, then replan and communicate the consequences as soon as a blocker or new information emerges
Hold teams accountable to their commitments, challenge engineering estimates and priorities, and escalate where delivery is slipping
Own the government interface, including the independent verification and validation (IV&V) relationship, planning test and evaluation against exit criteria and packaging results into the reporting and reviews sponsors expect
Own and track the programme budget, maintaining alignment between actual spend and the annual projections agreed with our investors, and flagging variances early
Develop funding proposals and manage subcontractors, including statements of work, deliverables, commercial terms and spend against plan
Prioritise across competing demands so effort lands on the highest-impact work
Communicate across levels, from technical detail with the teams through to concise high-level updates for management and the CEO
Work to defined programme and quality processes, applying them consistently across the programme
Build the processes, systems and tooling that help our researchers and engineers move faster

Your experience

A track record of delivering complex technical programmes against fixed external milestones, where the deadline does not move and the reporting bar is high
Experience owning detailed delivery schedules across hardware and software workstreams, including external partners and subcontractors
A background in hardware electronics, semiconductor, test engineering or manufacturing programme management, or another environment where hardware dependencies carry real schedule risk
A structured approach to risk, identifying dependencies early and maintaining credible mitigation plans rather than reporting problems after they land
Experience owning a programme budget, tracking spend against plan and reporting variance
Experience managing subcontractors, statements of work, deliverables and commercial terms
Comfortable operating to defined processes and formal quality requirements rather than improvising case by case
Willing to hold the line, challenging estimates and priorities and pushing back when delivery slips
Strong communication and stakeholder management in a matrix environment, adjusting register between engineers, management and executives
A fast learner, comfortable ramping up on unfamiliar technical domains and picking up the quantum and cryogenic vocabulary on the job
Experience delivering to government-funded research programmes or under independent evaluation is desirable but not essential

Equal opportunity

SQC is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and experiences, and encourage applications from candidates who may not meet every listed requirement. If you’re excited about the role and believe you can contribute, we encourage you to apply.

Export controls

This position may require access to export-controlled information or technology. Employment may be subject to applicable export control laws and may require eligibility assessment based on factors such as nationality, citizenship, or residency, and, where necessary, obtaining relevant export licenses or approvals.

About SQC

SQC was founded by renowned physicist and materials scientist Michelle Simmons, who pioneered the field of atomic electronics, including the development of the world’s first single-atom transistor and the first integrated circuit built with atomic precision. Our Chair, Simon Segars, former CEO of Arm, is a leader in the semiconductor industry and was instrumental in developing the processors that powered the mobile computing revolution.

As a full-stack company with in-house QPU manufacturing, SQC can design, produce and test new quantum chips in under a week, enabling rapid iteration and a decisive advantage in the race to build the world’s first commercial-scale quantum computer.

SQC is a high-accountability environment built on a simple principle: Every Atom Counts. If you’re looking to play a meaningful role in building the next frontier of computing, we’d love to hear from you.

You will work with engineers, product partners, QA, technical leads, and customers to keep strategic, customer-funded software projects moving across scope, schedule, budget, risk, and delivery.

Opportunity

This role provides overall project management for assigned strategic projects that support business growth and improve operating efficiency across a growing software company. You will manage work tied to long-range planning and near-term delivery goals in a Scrum/Agile environment, while also coordinating tasks, deadlines, status, and expectations with customers.

What You Will Own

Project planning and delivery

Manage customer-funded software projects from kickoff through completion, keeping work aligned to contractual scope, schedule, and budget.
Build and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, action items, risks, issues, and decision items.
Translate statements of work, contract modifications, and customer requirements into development activities and measurable outcomes.
Provide forward-looking project planning with attention to upcoming tasks, due dates, resource availability, and delivery commitments.
Set deadlines, assign responsibilities, manage key milestones, and summarize project progress for internal and external stakeholders.

Customer and stakeholder coordination

Serve as a primary point of contact for customers on assigned projects.
Lead recurring status meetings, technical discussions, demonstrations, training coordination, and project reviews.
Prepare customer-facing reports, presentations, project plans, meeting materials, and contract deliverables.
Identify known customer needs and route them to the appropriate team members.
Build and maintain strong working relationships with team members, vendors, customers, and departments contributing to project delivery.

Cross-functional software execution

Coordinate with technical leads, developers, QA personnel, product managers, application engineers, design engineers, and architecture partners to establish priorities and monitor progress.
Support product and release planning activities, including roadmap reviews, sprint planning, readiness reviews, and deployment coordination.
Identify risks, issues, roadblocks, and resource constraints early; develop mitigation plans and escalate concerns when needed.

Forecasting, reporting, and operating rhythm

Give employees task assignments with defined objectives, due dates, and estimated hours.
Support quarterly and annual planning with attention to past performance and future efforts.
Track, report, and review companywide KPIs, including revenue numbers and progress against priorities.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, communications, or a related field.
3+ years managing software development, technology implementation, or customer delivery projects.
Experience managing multiple technical projects with cross-functional teams.
Fluency in project or program management methodologies.
Hands-on experience with planning, implementation, work breakdown structures, risk management, cost estimating, schedule development, and related project management practices.
Experience preparing customer-facing reports, presentations, project plans, meeting materials, or contract deliverables.
A proven record of leading project execution activities and delivering results for business stakeholders.
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively across levels inside and outside the organization.
An analytical, detail-oriented approach combined with the ability to understand the bigger picture and how project decisions affect cross-functional teams.
Strong problem-solving skills, root-cause analysis, organization, follow-through, and ability to execute a plan.

Nice-to-Haves

Experience working with government or defense-related customers.
Experience managing government contracts with funded development work.
Experience working in Scrum/Agile and Waterfall software development environments.
Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or equivalent certification.

jobs.title: Slot Game Project Manager
jobs.description:
Slot Game Project Manager

We are looking for a **Slot Game Project Manager** who deeply understands online slots and can translate a client's vision into a game our development and design teams can execute.

This is not a traditional project management role. You need to genuinely understand **slot games, mechanics, features, themes, and player experiences**. You will work directly with clients to understand what they want to build, help shape those ideas into a complete game concept, and coordinate our internal teams through development and launch.

## What You'll Do

### Client & Game Discovery

* Speak directly with clients to understand the type of slot they want to create.
* Ask the right questions to uncover their preferred gameplay, mechanics, volatility, themes, features, art direction, and overall player experience.
* Take incomplete or loosely defined ideas and turn them into a clear, actionable game concept.
* Advise clients on mechanics and features based on your knowledge of existing slots and the broader slot market.
* Present game concepts, features, and development progress clearly to clients.

### Slot Game Expertise

You should have a strong understanding of slot mechanics, including:

* Wilds and expanding/sticky/multiplier wilds
* Scatters
* Free spins
* Bonus rounds
* Multipliers
* Cascades / tumbling reels
* Ways-to-win and paylines
* Hold-and-win mechanics
* Collect mechanics
* Respins
* Progressive features
* Buy bonuses
* Megaways-style mechanics
* Jackpots
* Volatility and player experience
* RTP and basic slot mathematics concepts

You should also have a strong knowledge of **existing slot games and slot history**.

If a client says they want something that feels like a combination of several popular games, you should immediately understand the references, what makes those games successful, and which elements can be incorporated into a new concept.

### Translate Vision Into Development

* Turn customer conversations into detailed game requirements for developers, artists, animators, mathematicians, and sound designers.
* Create and maintain game specifications, feature descriptions, reference materials, and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure everyone working on the game understands exactly what is being built and why.
* Identify gaps or contradictions in a game concept before development begins.
* Work with the team to refine mechanics where needed while preserving the client's original vision.

### Manage Multiple Games

* Manage several slot projects simultaneously at different stages of development.
* Coordinate developers, designers, artists, mathematicians, QA, and other contributors.
* Maintain timelines, milestones, deliverables, and priorities.
* Track feedback and ensure client revisions are implemented correctly.
* Identify blockers early and push projects toward completion.
* Keep both the client and internal team informed throughout development.

## What We're Looking For

* **Deep knowledge of online slot games is essential.**
* You actively play, study, or have worked with a wide range of slot games and providers.
* You can explain why different slot mechanics work and how they affect the player experience.
* Strong knowledge of major slot titles, studios, mechanics, trends, and the evolution of slot games.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Strong ability to listen to a client, understand what they actually want, and translate it into clear instructions.
* Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable giving opinions and recommendations rather than simply taking orders.
* Able to communicate effectively with both creative and technical teams.
* Strong ownership mentality—you are responsible for getting the game from **idea to finished product**.

## Nice to Have

* Previous experience at a slot studio, iGaming company, casino supplier, or game development studio.
* Experience as a slot producer, game producer, game designer, product manager, or project manager.
* Familiarity with slot mathematics, RTP, hit frequency, volatility, and bonus frequency.
* Familiarity with major studios such as Pragmatic Play, Hacksaw Gaming, Nolimit City, Relax Gaming, Push Gaming, Play'n GO, Evolution/NetEnt, Blueprint, or similar.
* Experience working directly with streamers, casino operators, game studios, or other clients.
* Experience with Jira, Linear, Notion, ClickUp, or similar project management tools.

## What Success Looks Like

A great Slot Game Project Manager should be able to sit down with a client who says:

*"I like the bonus system from this game, the wild mechanic from this game, and the pacing of this other game, but I want it built around my own theme."*

You should be able to understand exactly what they mean, challenge or improve the concept where appropriate, document the game clearly, explain it to the development team, manage the project through production, and ultimately deliver a game that matches—or improves upon—the client's original vision.

jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst who can turn complex business data into clear insights, reliable reporting, and practical recommendations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys investigating business questions, developing useful dashboards, and helping teams understand what drives performance.

You will work with business stakeholders and technical teams to define meaningful metrics, improve reporting accuracy, and identify opportunities across operations, customer experience, and business performance. The role combines hands-on analysis with direct stakeholder collaboration, giving you ownership of analytical projects from the initial question through to recommendations and follow-up measurement.

Key Responsibilities

Translate business questions into analytical plans, clear requirements, and measurable outcomes.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, combine, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Build and maintain dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable visualization platform.
Analyze trends, investigate performance changes, and explain the factors behind key results.
Define and document KPIs, reporting logic, and metric calculations to support consistent decision-making.
Validate datasets, investigate discrepancies, and collaborate with data teams to resolve quality issues.
Automate recurring reports and reduce manual work while maintaining accuracy.
Present findings in concise reports and presentations tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Partner with stakeholders to prioritize requests and establish realistic delivery timelines.
Measure the results of business initiatives and recommend next steps based on the evidence.

Required Qualifications

4–8 years of relevant experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or a closely related analytical role.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, common table expressions, window functions, and aggregations.
Hands-on experience with Power BI or Tableau; expertise in either platform is sufficient.
Strong Excel skills for analysis, reconciliation, and reporting.
Experience working with relational databases and combining information from multiple datasets.
Practical understanding of descriptive statistics, data validation, and analytical problem-solving.
Ability to distinguish between correlation and causation and communicate limitations in the data.
Experience gathering stakeholder requirements and independently delivering analytical projects.
Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain findings and their business implications.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Working knowledge of Python or R for analysis and automation.
Exposure to a cloud data platform such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Azure.
Familiarity with data modeling, ETL/ELT workflows, and version control.
Experience with forecasting, cohort analysis, customer segmentation, or A/B testing.
Experience improving reporting processes or supporting self-service analytics.

Preferred qualifications are helpful, but candidates do not need experience with every listed tool.

What Success Looks Like

Stakeholders have access to accurate, understandable, and timely reporting.
Key metrics use consistent definitions and documented calculations.
Analysis explains the reasons behind performance changes and supports actionable decisions.
Recurring reporting requires less manual effort.
Findings are communicated clearly, including assumptions and limitations.

How to Apply

Submit your resume highlighting relevant analytical projects, the tools you used, and the business outcomes you supported. A portfolio is welcome but optional; please exclude confidential employer or client information.

Slot Game Project Manager

We are looking for a **Slot Game Project Manager** who deeply understands online slots and can translate a client's vision into a game our development and design teams can execute.

This is not a traditional project management role. You need to genuinely understand **slot games, mechanics, features, themes, and player experiences**. You will work directly with clients to understand what they want to build, help shape those ideas into a complete game concept, and coordinate our internal teams through development and launch.

## What You'll Do

### Client & Game Discovery

* Speak directly with clients to understand the type of slot they want to create.
* Ask the right questions to uncover their preferred gameplay, mechanics, volatility, themes, features, art direction, and overall player experience.
* Take incomplete or loosely defined ideas and turn them into a clear, actionable game concept.
* Advise clients on mechanics and features based on your knowledge of existing slots and the broader slot market.
* Present game concepts, features, and development progress clearly to clients.

### Slot Game Expertise

You should have a strong understanding of slot mechanics, including:

* Wilds and expanding/sticky/multiplier wilds
* Scatters
* Free spins
* Bonus rounds
* Multipliers
* Cascades / tumbling reels
* Ways-to-win and paylines
* Hold-and-win mechanics
* Collect mechanics
* Respins
* Progressive features
* Buy bonuses
* Megaways-style mechanics
* Jackpots
* Volatility and player experience
* RTP and basic slot mathematics concepts

You should also have a strong knowledge of **existing slot games and slot history**.

If a client says they want something that feels like a combination of several popular games, you should immediately understand the references, what makes those games successful, and which elements can be incorporated into a new concept.

### Translate Vision Into Development

* Turn customer conversations into detailed game requirements for developers, artists, animators, mathematicians, and sound designers.
* Create and maintain game specifications, feature descriptions, reference materials, and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure everyone working on the game understands exactly what is being built and why.
* Identify gaps or contradictions in a game concept before development begins.
* Work with the team to refine mechanics where needed while preserving the client's original vision.

### Manage Multiple Games

* Manage several slot projects simultaneously at different stages of development.
* Coordinate developers, designers, artists, mathematicians, QA, and other contributors.
* Maintain timelines, milestones, deliverables, and priorities.
* Track feedback and ensure client revisions are implemented correctly.
* Identify blockers early and push projects toward completion.
* Keep both the client and internal team informed throughout development.

## What We're Looking For

* **Deep knowledge of online slot games is essential.**
* You actively play, study, or have worked with a wide range of slot games and providers.
* You can explain why different slot mechanics work and how they affect the player experience.
* Strong knowledge of major slot titles, studios, mechanics, trends, and the evolution of slot games.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Strong ability to listen to a client, understand what they actually want, and translate it into clear instructions.
* Highly organized and comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Comfortable giving opinions and recommendations rather than simply taking orders.
* Able to communicate effectively with both creative and technical teams.
* Strong ownership mentality—you are responsible for getting the game from **idea to finished product**.

## Nice to Have

* Previous experience at a slot studio, iGaming company, casino supplier, or game development studio.
* Experience as a slot producer, game producer, game designer, product manager, or project manager.
* Familiarity with slot mathematics, RTP, hit frequency, volatility, and bonus frequency.
* Familiarity with major studios such as Pragmatic Play, Hacksaw Gaming, Nolimit City, Relax Gaming, Push Gaming, Play'n GO, Evolution/NetEnt, Blueprint, or similar.
* Experience working directly with streamers, casino operators, game studios, or other clients.
* Experience with Jira, Linear, Notion, ClickUp, or similar project management tools.

## What Success Looks Like

A great Slot Game Project Manager should be able to sit down with a client who says:

*"I like the bonus system from this game, the wild mechanic from this game, and the pacing of this other game, but I want it built around my own theme."*

You should be able to understand exactly what they mean, challenge or improve the concept where appropriate, document the game clearly, explain it to the development team, manage the project through production, and ultimately deliver a game that matches—or improves upon—the client's original vision.

Understand.

Turn insights into concrete opportunities and hypotheses for testing. Explore new products features, growth initiatives, monetization opportunities, and improvements to how the business operates, prioritizing those with the greatest potential impact.

Reasoning ability.

new_jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Data Analyst who can turn complex business data into clear insights, reliable reporting, and practical recommendations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys investigating business questions, developing useful dashboards, and helping teams understand what drives performance.

You will work with business stakeholders and technical teams to define meaningful metrics, improve reporting accuracy, and identify opportunities across operations, customer experience, and business performance. The role combines hands-on analysis with direct stakeholder collaboration, giving you ownership of analytical projects from the initial question through to recommendations and follow-up measurement.

Key Responsibilities

Translate business questions into analytical plans, clear requirements, and measurable outcomes.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, combine, and analyze data from multiple sources.
Build and maintain dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable visualization platform.
Analyze trends, investigate performance changes, and explain the factors behind key results.
Define and document KPIs, reporting logic, and metric calculations to support consistent decision-making.
Validate datasets, investigate discrepancies, and collaborate with data teams to resolve quality issues.
Automate recurring reports and reduce manual work while maintaining accuracy.
Present findings in concise reports and presentations tailored to technical and nontechnical audiences.
Partner with stakeholders to prioritize requests and establish realistic delivery timelines.
Measure the results of business initiatives and recommend next steps based on the evidence.

Required Qualifications

4–8 years of relevant experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or a closely related analytical role.
Strong SQL skills, including joins, common table expressions, window functions, and aggregations.
Hands-on experience with Power BI or Tableau; expertise in either platform is sufficient.
Strong Excel skills for analysis, reconciliation, and reporting.
Experience working with relational databases and combining information from multiple datasets.
Practical understanding of descriptive statistics, data validation, and analytical problem-solving.
Ability to distinguish between correlation and causation and communicate limitations in the data.
Experience gathering stakeholder requirements and independently delivering analytical projects.
Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain findings and their business implications.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

Working knowledge of Python or R for analysis and automation.
Exposure to a cloud data platform such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, or Azure.
Familiarity with data modeling, ETL/ELT workflows, and version control.
Experience with forecasting, cohort analysis, customer segmentation, or A/B testing.
Experience improving reporting processes or supporting self-service analytics.

Preferred qualifications are helpful, but candidates do not need experience with every listed tool.

What Success Looks Like

Stakeholders have access to accurate, understandable, and timely reporting.
Key metrics use consistent definitions and documented calculations.
Analysis explains the reasons behind performance changes and supports actionable decisions.
Recurring reporting requires less manual effort.
Findings are communicated clearly, including assumptions and limitations.

How to Apply

Submit your resume highlighting relevant analytical projects, the tools you used, and the business outcomes you supported. A portfolio is welcome but optional; please exclude confidential employer or client information.

McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve - we care.

About The Role

The Senior Business Intelligence Analyst at McKesson is a highly visible, hands-on individual contributor responsible for building and scaling AIM28's analytics, reporting, and value-realization measurement capabilities. Reporting directly to the AIM28 Finance Lead, this role involves designing and owning end-to-end data models, ETL pipelines, dashboards, and automation solutions that transform complex, fragmented data into trusted insights for executives and program leaders. The role also entails supporting strategic projects as needed, ensuring that data-driven decision-making is optimized across the organization.

The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise in SQL, data modeling, BI visualization, automation, and AI-enabled analytics, combined with strong business and finance acumen. Operating as the sole analytics builder within the AIM28 Finance team, you will create the program's single source of truth for KPIs, benefits, investments, and value realization reporting. You will drive self-service analytics, reporting automation, and AI-powered insights across the AIM28 portfolio, facilitating faster and more accurate decision-making processes. This role offers an opportunity to work on high-impact projects that shape the future of healthcare transformation through innovative data solutions.

Qualifications

The successful candidate will bring a combination of technical mastery and business understanding. Key qualifications include:

Proven experience as a data builder or analyst with a focus on SQL development, data modeling, and dashboard creation.
Strong knowledge of data design principles, ETL/ELT processes, and automation techniques.
Experience working with raw data, manual files, and scattered dashboards, transforming them into integrated, reliable reports.
Deep understanding of financial concepts such as ROI, forecasting, variance analysis, and business-case logic.
Comfort working independently in a finance environment, owning the full analytics stack from requirements gathering to deployment and adoption.
Excellent communication skills, capable of presenting complex insights to senior leadership clearly and effectively.
